description.translate: Twelve iron ingots for window guards and the signal frame. Leave the doors usable. We are sheltering travellers, not protecting an empty building from them. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The Inferno was stronger than the force facing it. Once the retreat began, The Ranker fought to buy the wounded another moment. That final courage belongs beside his impatience and the help he had left unfinished. Both are part of what happened.
